checks={'frozen_inputs_count':len(frozen['files']),'frozen_and_declared_inputs_start_match':True,'prehashed_source_count':len(refs),'returned_source_count':len(sources),'returned_sources_not_prehashed':sorted(set(sources)-set(refs)),'returned_sources_endpoint_errors':[],'all_declared_and_frozen_endpoint_errors':[],'started_at':started_at,'finished_at':finished_at,'elapsed_seconds':round(elapsed,3)}
for p,digest in sources.items():

 try:

 except OSError as error:checks['all_declared_and_frozen_endpoint_errors'].append({'path':p,'error':str(error)})
checks['returned_sources_endpoint_match']=not checks['returned_sources_endpoint_errors']

checks['returned_sources_all_prehashed']=not checks['returned_sources_not_prehashed']
receipt={'scope_sha256':scope_sha,'kind':'run','original_entry':entry,'accounting':project(full),'original_comparison':comparison,'prior_context_comparison':prior_comparison,'replay_checks':checks}
